name: St Louis Spring Co.
old_description: The St. Louis Spring Company makes custom leaf spring suspension for almost any kind of vehicle.  We are one of the oldest continuously operating leaf spring manufacturers in the country.  Our second generation family-owned shop has been handcrafting custom leaf springs for America’s cars and vehicles using time-honored techniques for more than a hundred years.
about:
Founded more than a century ago in St. Louis, Missouri, the St. Louis Spring Company has operated continuously as a second‑generation family‑owned business. The shop specializes in handcrafted leaf‑spring suspension systems for virtually any vehicle type, maintaining time‑honored fabrication methods throughout its history.

The company produces custom leaf springs, u‑bolts, and a range of stock suspension components including bushings, inserts, clips, and center bolts. All springs are built from heavy‑duty, high‑quality steel sourced from U.S. mills. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers span a broad spectrum of automotive and industrial segments: classic cars, muscle cars, hot rods, pickup trucks, Jeeps, SUVs, trailers, heavy vehicles such as fire trucks and dump trucks, commercial and semi trucks, tow trucks, agricultural equipment, demolition‑derby vehicles, utility vehicles, tractors, golf carts, monster trucks, vans and sprinter vans, brush hogs, mobile homes, and RVs or campers.

The firm emphasizes durability from domestic steel, extensive customization capability — lifting or lowering arches, adding leaves, or upgrading material — and rapid turnaround, with most orders shipped within a week and many in just a few days.

The company is a member of the Edge Group, a distributor-owned buying and marketing group headquartered in Houston, Texas, that comprises more than 100 independent distributors and offers access to over 200 product lines from manufacturers.

The company stocks thousands of electronic components across categories such as soldering supplies, connectors, transistors, cables, heat-shrink tubing, diodes, batteries, fuses, tools, capacitors, banana plugs, and resistors. Beyond its own webstore, Standard Supply Electronics sells through Amazon and eBay marketplaces, extending its reach to customers who prefer those platforms.

Its customer base spans the datacom, security, low-voltage, electronic MRO, and electronic OEM sectors. The Edge Group membership allows Standard Supply Electronics to source material and leverage collective inventory for buyers in those industries.

The company emphasizes that its group affiliation gives it the purchasing power and inventory depth of a much larger organization, enabling it to supply hard-to-find items and support both maintenance and original-equipment production needs.

old_description: can supply you with the right sizes, types, and quantities of product you need to keep you on schedule and your management happy. We have been doing this for companies since 1947.
about:
Standard Wire & Cable Co. has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since its founding in 1947. The company began as a supplier of electronic wire and cable and has grown to serve domestic and international markets.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures commercial, military, and industrial electronic and electrical wire and cable. It maintains an inventory of over 25,000 distinct wire and cable types across more than 57,000 square feet of warehouse space at multiple locations. In addition to stocked products, Standard Wire & Cable provides custom cable fabrication and custom heat‑shrink shape manufacturing, offering design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions tailored to customer requirements.

Its customer base spans military, commercial, and industrial sectors, with an export department that handles international shipments, including export documentation and packaging. The company serves clients worldwide, leveraging its large inventory for just‑in‑time delivery.

Standard Wire & Cable emphasizes quality assurance, holding ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications, and its export operations earned the U.S. Department of Commerce President’s “E” Award for excellence. The company states that its combination of extensive stock, custom fabrication, and certified quality management sets it apart.

name: Standex Electronics Inc
old_description: We have refreshed our brand and website to reflect our evolution as a global engineering partner. Our rebrand aligns our teams, technologies, and customers around a shared commitment to deliver the right design, at the right time, at the optimal cost. Learn more about this transformation in our official press release.
about:
Standex Electronics operates from its headquarters in Fairfield, Ohio, as a global platform company that unifies three specialized divisions: Standex Detect, Standex Edge, and Standex Grid. The business traces its roots through generations of innovation in electronic components, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Over time, strategic acquisitions — including Amran and Narayan Powertech, which now anchor the Grid division — have expanded its portfolio into a diversified, vertically integrated operation.

The company designs and manufactures precision-engineered electronic components spanning switching and sensing technologies, power magnetics, and grid solutions. Its product range includes reed switches, relays, sensors, custom transformers, planar transformers, inductors, chokes, EMI components, and low- to medium-voltage instrument transformers. Standex emphasizes deep vertical integration, which it says enables consistent quality, rapid prototyping, and an engineer-to-engineer collaborative approach. Manufacturing facilities, design centers, and sales offices are distributed across North America, Europe, and Asia, providing local support backed by global resources.

Standex serves mission-critical markets including automotive (passenger, commercial, off-road, construction, and agriculture), aerospace and defense, medical, industrial automation, telecommunications, renewable and alternative energy, and electrical utilities. Customers range from OEMs developing smart-home and transportation systems to utilities modernizing grid infrastructure. The company positions its three divisions to address distinct but complementary needs: Detect for switching and sensing, Edge for magnetics in power conversion, and Grid for instrument transformers and high-voltage components.

Standex says its differentiation lies in the combination of a global footprint with local engineering intimacy, a legacy of innovation across reed switches, magnetics, and power-grid technologies, and a unified operating philosophy — Innovate, Consult, Engineer, Deliver — that guides every program from concept through production. The integration of acquired brands such as Amran and Narayan Powertech into Standex Grid underscores a strategy of building on established expertise to solve evolving challenges in electrification and connectivity.

name: State Fabricators Inc
old_description: State Fabricators, Inc. is a welding and fabrication company that has been producing quality, custom steel fabrications for over 60 years. State Fabricators, affectionately known as StateFab, has flexible systems in place that allow us to excel at large production jobs as well as small prototype fabrications.
about:
State Fabricators Inc., known as StateFab, has operated from Farmington Hills, Michigan since its founding in 1946. The company began in a 1,900‑square‑foot space and grew into a production welding shop that now occupies 26,000 square feet under crane on a seven‑acre site with room to stage large jobs.

The shop focuses on custom steel fabrication and production welding, delivering everything from single prototypes to thousand‑unit runs. Its core processes include fixture‑based welding, custom assembly, and large‑scale steel fabrication.

StateFab serves the automotive industry as a long‑time Tier One and Tier Two supplier. Its product portfolio centers on conveyor‑system components: overhead, inverted, skillet, ELPO, paint, door, and cab carriers, as well as line platforms and robot gantries built for tight installation windows. The company also produces skillet frames and custom assemblies for plants across North America.

The company emphasizes repeatability and quality control. A quality manual has been in use since 1997, and certified welders work with dedicated checking fixtures so that each subassembly meets the same standard whether the run is one unit or a thousand. Flexible systems allow the shop to move between large production jobs and small prototype fabrications without changing its workflow.

name: State Medical Equipment
old_description: We are a family and locally owned durable medical supply company committed to providing our customers with the best quality medical supplies and exceptional customer service. We have nearly a decade of experience, serving patients and healthcare facilities with sales and rental solutions across the Las Vegas Valley.
about:
State Medical Equipment is a family-owned durable medical equipment supplier based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Established nearly a decade ago, the company serves the Las Vegas Valley, including Henderson, Summerlin, and surrounding communities in Southern Nevada.

The company sells and rents a broad range of home medical equipment, including mobility aids such as wheelchairs, scooters, walkers, and power chairs; respiratory devices like oxygen concentrators and nebulizers; hospital beds and patient lifts; power lift chairs; and bathroom safety products such as shower chairs, commodes, and grab bars. It operates a retail showroom where customers can view equipment in person, and provides in-home delivery, installation, and setup. A dedicated after-hours team offers emergency support outside normal business hours, and the company also performs professional service and repair on medical equipment.

State Medical Equipment serves individual patients, caregivers, and healthcare facilities, as well as visitors to Las Vegas who need temporary equipment. Testimonials highlight travelers who forgot CPAP components and received replacements within hours, families renting wheelchairs and lift chairs for elderly relatives, and facilities arranging hospital bed rentals on short notice.

The company emphasizes its highly trained staff, transparent pricing, and rapid response — including after-hours delivery — as key differentiators. Its combination of a physical retail location, comprehensive rental programs, and on-site service capabilities allows it to support both short-term visitor needs and long-term home care requirements.

about:
State Wire & Terminal, Inc. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, just outside Detroit. The company began as a distributor of electrical components for maintenance and repair applications.

The company distributes electrical components for maintenance and repair across various industries, stocking over 100,000 parts from manufacturers such as 3M, Deutsch, HellermannTyton, and Pollak. More than 12,000 items are available for same-day shipping. In addition to electrical components, State Wire & Terminal offers a line of storage solutions including component kit boxes, bearing racks, bins, and wire spool racks. An inventory management system helps customers anticipate needs and avoid stockouts, and a Will Call counter at the Auburn Hills facility allows for immediate pickup of hundreds of items.

State Wire & Terminal serves a broad range of motor-powered industries. Its customer base includes utilities (electric, gas, water and sewage), recreational vehicle manufacturers, construction firms, trucking operations, government and municipal agencies, and marine applications. The company also supplies hospitals, HVAC contractors, schools, farms, and other motorized industries.

The company emphasizes saving customers time and money through fast parts delivery and inventory management. Its system anticipates demand to prevent stockouts, and customer service staff assist with restocking. Same-day shipping on thousands of items and a Will Call counter for immediate pickup further differentiate the service.

name: Steel Tectonics Inc
old_description: Founded in 2006 - Shawn Nelson, President of STI Machining purchased a small machine shop that was running out of a garage. There he found his love of machining, since then he has doubled the production of the business both climates and production. Operating out of an 8000 sq ft building housing half a dozen machines.
about:
Steel Tectonics Inc., doing business as STI Machining, was founded in 2006 in West Jordan, Utah, when Shawn Nelson purchased a small garage-based machine shop. The family-run operation has since grown into an 8,000-square-foot facility housing half a dozen CNC machines. Nelson’s two sons, Cody and Justin, are now learning the trade and beginning to take on leadership roles.

The shop specializes in high-performance plastics machining, offering 2- to 4-axis CNC capabilities and design-for-manufacture consulting. Materials processed include PFA, polypropylene, PTFE, acetal, and PVDF. The team emphasizes precision tooling and optimized speeds and feeds to achieve superior surface finishes on plastic components.

The primary customer base is the semiconductor industry, where the company’s expertise in the unique challenges of plastic machining—such as dimensional stability and contamination control—is a key differentiator. STI also supports product design teams to improve manufacturability and cost.

Founded on Nelson’s 25-plus years of machining experience, the business prioritizes craftsmanship and responsive service, with a stated focus on meeting tight lead times and maintaining clear communication throughout each project.
